library.help.other: Files are private. Collection metadata permission does not grant download or deletion.

library.page_help.other: At most 25 files per page; pages are not a shared snapshot.

delete.confirm.other: I confirm deletion of this file.

asset.denied.other: Download or deletion of this file is not permitted.

status.help.other: After an unknown upload outcome, do not replay automatically. Inspect a known ID. Without an ID, library inspection is only evidence: filenames can repeat; the product operator must inspect unfinished work.

upload.help.other: At most 10 MiB. Allowed extensions: {Extensions}. Original-byte downloads; no previews or conversion. Filenames are not unique.

upload.help.images.other: At most 10 MiB. Allowed extensions: {Extensions}. PNG/JPEG: at most {MaxDimension} per dimension and {MaxPixels} pixels. Original-byte downloads; no previews or conversion. Filenames are not unique.

status.result.other: Asset {ID}: {State}, revision {Revision}. Inspect the library for ready files.

upload.unknown.other: Outcome unknown. Do not upload again automatically. Inspect a known ID; otherwise inspect the permitted library and contact the product operator. Filenames can repeat and cannot identify this operation.

permissions.unavailable.other: Permission checks are temporarily unavailable. Actions are disabled; refresh to check them again. Completed uploads remain saved.
